summary: Backend Engineer specializing in Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, experienced in designing and optimizing high-performance REST APIs and scalable backend solutions. Skilled in authentication, authorization, Redis caching, and deploying applications using Docker and AWS. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust backend services aligned with business goals.

bullets: Engineered scalable backend services using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Redis to support high-performance profile and matching workflows.
Designed and optimized REST APIs for profile analysis and job matchmaking systems to enhance efficiency and relevance.
Built optimized text searching indices to improve query performance and matchmaking accuracy.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams translating business requirements into robust technical backend solutions.
Led backend development of a healthcare CRM with scalable REST APIs for patient management and appointment scheduling.
Developed secure authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) systems to safeguard data and comply with regulations.
Ensured data protection and regulatory compliance across the platform.
Utilized Docker for backend application containerization.
Developed backend systems and REST APIs using Django, FastAPI, Node.js, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Designed relational and NoSQL database architectures for multiple domains.
Built secure authentication and authorization systems.
Delivered scalable backend solutions across healthcare, education, and SaaS sectors.
Developed backend services using Django and MySQL, creating scalable REST APIs.
Optimized SQL queries and database indexing to improve platform performance and response times.
